_comment: Pins of flow A1' (score/ppa.py, WP-X4): the canonical RTLIL of the pinned flow mapped by a real `abc -liberty` run onto sky130_fd_sc_hd,
then weighed exactly as A0' is (same liberty, same STA, same timing setup, same constants policy: ppa_pins.json). The Yosys script is
score/ppa_mapped.ys (its sha256 is recorded beside this file's). Everything a mapped number depends on besides the canonical RTLIL and the
code is in these two files, the liberty, and the tool builds named here. Change any of them and `ppa_mapped_version` must change.
A1' NEVER replaces A0': the fields have their own names (area_um2_sky130_mapped_v1, mapped_delay_sky130_v1, ...), their own version and
their own hashes, and neither flow is official. Study: design/ppa/sky130.md (WP-X1, variant `u`); what it claims: score/PPA.md.

tools._comment: The builds the pinned numbers were measured with. ppa.py RECORDS the live versions in every mapped block and never refuses another build (the pinned flow of score.py does not either); tests/run.py and score/test_ppa.py compare the goldens against them and fail when they differ, so a different build is a loud difference, not a silent one. ABC is built into Yosys: its banner is read from the Yosys log.

_timeout_comment: The mapping run of one design may take at most yosys_timeout_s (wall clock); a design whose mapping takes longer has `mapped: {available: false, reason: ...timed out...}` and nothing else changes. The pinned flow of score.py has its own limit; 900 s is far above the longest mapping measured on the 24 reference, baseline and idiom designs (a few seconds).

script._comment: abc_script is documentation (the .ys file is the pin and its text is checked against this string by test_ppa.py): Yosys 0.53's default for `abc -liberty` without -constr, written out.

equivalence._comment: Before a mapped netlist is weighed it is simulated, bit-parallel through the liberty's own cell functions, against the scored netlist on `vectors` input vectors (vector 0 all zeros, vector 1 all ones, the rest SHA-256(seed || k) bits) and must agree on every output bit. A sample, not a proof: it catches a mapper or reader defect that changes the function broadly, and nothing narrower.
